title: An Interview with Dr. Randy Pardell About Advocating for Mental Health
subtitle: An early TMS adopter takes his family story and uses it to heal others
body_html:
My wife, , is a board member of the Foundation for the Advancement of Clinical TMS. This organization features her dear friend, and mine, Dr. Randy Pardell, as President. He's an early adopter of transcranial magnetic stimulation, and a real giant in the field of psychiatry. He's also someone with a rich family life that deeply informs his work. With a mother who trained as a psychologist, and two children who work as his company, Clearwave Mental Health’s, employment, lawyer, and CEO, respectively—family plays a crucial role in the story that Randy brings to his work as a healer. We sat down for about an hour. He was sure wouldn't be a podcast recording, and only preparation, and ended up being a pretty good podcast recording anyway! I hope you enjoy it!

You can find this gracious doctor, and his practice, at the links below:

Randy I. Pardell MD DLFAPA, FCTMSS

Chief Medical Officer, Clearwave Mental Health

President, Foundation for the Advancement of Clinical TMS FACTMS.org

I would also strongly encourage donations to FACTMS.org. They are bringing awareness of treatment and supporting research and clinical care for those without means. If you believe in the work that I write about, and want to make a donation? This is a great organization to support!
